entities.name: Archaeal eS17
observations: The 71-aa query exactly matches reviewed UniProt A4WH03 (Pyrobaculum arsenaticum) across its full length; annotated as small ribosomal subunit protein eS17.
Reference annotations assign it to the ribosome/cytosol, structural constituent of ribosome, and translation (GO:0005840, GO:0005829, GO:0003735, GO:0006412).

entities.name: Translation
observations: GO:0006412 is annotated for the exact-match eS17 reference protein; supports involvement in translation.
